title: Staff Distributed Systems Engineer
summary: Staff Software Engineer with 9+ years of experience designing high-throughput distributed systems, event-driven microservices, and resilient cloud storage engines. Experienced in Go, TypeScript, Rust, Kubernetes, and SQLite/PostgreSQL internals. Passionate about local-first software, zero-downtime migrations, and deterministic testing.

achievements: Architected a real-time event ingestion engine processing 350,000 events/sec with sub-15ms p99 latency using Go and Kafka.
Engineered an automated partition balancing protocol that reduced cluster rebalance failover time from 12 minutes to 18 seconds.
Spearheaded the migration of 40TB transactional SQLite/PostgreSQL storage to an active-passive replicated topology with zero downtime.
Mentored 6 senior and staff engineers, authored RFCs for cross-region data synchronization, and established team-wide chaos engineering practices.
Designed and maintained Kubernetes operator controlling 1,200+ containerized workloads across multi-region AWS environments.
Built distributed rate-limiting and circuit-breaker middleware in Go/TypeScript, eliminating cascading upstream outages.
Optimized Docker container build caching and CI/CD pipelines, decreasing release deployment cycle duration from 38 minutes to 4 minutes.
Reduced cloud infrastructure expenditures by $420,000 annually through dynamic resource autoscaling and spot instance orchestration.
Implemented high-concurrency REST and GraphQL APIs serving 20M daily active requests using Node.js and TypeScript.
Designed robust data migration pipelines from legacy MySQL shards to normalized PostgreSQL clusters.
Achieved 99.98% service uptime across critical customer-facing authentication and authorization microservices.
